review.verdict_scope: Static independent SSI v9 design validation only; no run, observation, scientific result, hypothesis transition, official state transition, or execution authorization.
blocking_residuals: The immutable snapshot receipt is not self-bound to commit_sha even though the requested commit and all path hashes are verifiable.
Universal framing is stated, but numeric tags and complete digest/preimage grammars are missing for several named nested frames; the query-attempt seed explicitly omits payload_len.
Builder request and terminal overhead, terminal_reason bounds, and complete null/non-null record layouts are not included in total-size inequalities.
Named FOE events are not mapped one-to-one to numeric event codes, and the memory table lacks live-range endpoints needed to recompute peak memory.
Certificate/provider/mirror source equality, complete certificate size, HNF operation semantics, factor-to-matrix semantics, and witness validity are not fully closed.
Paired replay/null is specified but not materialized and lacks explicit branch-null zero/exhaustion behavior.
C-pair and synthetic controls explicitly lack measured material and independent receipts, so they remain INVALID_CONTROL for admission.
INCUMBENT-FOE-v1 has null FOE/memory/source fields and correctly blocks comparison, break-even, freeze, and improvement claims.
